This app is wonderfull. It allows me to have a daily checklist of things I need to do (take meds, brush teeth, etc) that's easy and quick to access and edit.   No unnecessary ads, and doesn't ask to rate the app every 10 minutes.

The most simple and useful application I have ever seen. I am so satisfied with the quality of the application. By the way you can make few developments. Insertable sub habits are good idea. Aren't it? For example I am doing different exercises. I wanna see my exercise under a topic with subgroups like football kickboxing and fitness separately but inside of a topic.

Expensive, but good. There are a few things missing though: - Have a habit multiple times a day!! - Make habits possible per month / year! - Habits for seasons aka disabling habits for some time (ea I cannot cycle in the winter months; in the summertime I won't take vitamin D etc, skipping a habit everyday for months would be just annoying) - Changable sound for ticking a habit done - Optional smaller UI, I have ~50 habits and can only see 5 1/2 at a time, a bit annoying. Or just subhabits.

Listen. I just got this app because I needed a minimalist daily checklist--just a morning routine with no timers or any of that. (Timers are great, but not necessarily for everything.) This app does exactly what I wanted it to, but the rabbit feature is massively growing on me! So stinking cute, and this app does an amazing job of keeping the content minimalist, while also providing OPTIONAL bonus features that are really useful!

this is not helpful for someone with ADHD it does not break down tasks into manageable chunks, just "tidy up" you have to then go into each item and create a sub-task list... which you can't see separately and keeps trying to sell you therapy!

I often make lists broken down by rooms to get cleaning done - so far loving this major and sub task system. Just wish this would be a little cheaper. This is a self help app that could help a lot of people. if the price was brought down a bit it could reach a lot more people.

love this app! It's been so great for boosting my health and productivity. I can create habits with subtasks, enable a drink water reminder, which is awesome, and provide personalized recommendations based on my weight and gender. It also includes videos on face yoga, fitness routines, and more. The only drawback is that some of the best content requires a subscription. Despite this, highly recommend the app to anyone struggling with productivity or procrastination!!!

I wanted to use this app primarily for a cleaning schedule but I was disappointed that there's no option to select a pre-made routine. I guess I didn't read well enough because when I saw advertised cleaning schedules I didn't realise that they were just printable ones. I wish there were templates to use for the digital aspect of things. I could have printed off a check list on my own.

so one star might not be fair or accurate since I haven't explored the whole app yet, however the ad I saw showed one specific feature that drew and motivated me only for that feature to "seemingly" not be a thing. the add showed a girl following a check list of "activities" ment to inspire cleaning in a way that makes it feel like a game, and this app just feels like a glorified check list, because you can add "do a game-like cleaning" but there's no check list involved.

It's honestly great instead of every other app this one is great help like it has not just a checklist but if you click on it you can make another checklist it may sound strange but if you wanted to make a morning routine all you do is just Make it put tasks you do in the morning and make it repeat. Again it is really really easy and helpful if you find routine hard download this app it will help.

I'm trying to find a good daily planner so I can remember to take my pills along with other stuff, but nope! You have to pay to be able to have more than one task. This app doesn't even have a widget for a checklist. Knowing me, I'll probably forget to go into the app it's self to check stuff off. If I could have more than one thing.

This app is easy to use, not complicated, not cluttered, and has a clean UI. Adding habits is easy. Habit can be customized with an icon and a theme color. There is also capability to add tasks. You can add sub-tasks, attach image, assign priority, and organize tasks into lists. Habits completion and streak can be tracked on a statistics dashboard. There is also a home screen "journey" dashboard that shows a snapshot of the habits for quick status update.

i would love if you could split a task into sub tasks. Like: "Clean the Bedroom" then multiple sub tasks containing picking up trash or vacuum etc. Also adding them to my homescreen like a widget would be cool but not necessary. Good app so far tho.

My daughter and I use this app almost everyday! she loves the checklist and timer function - now our bedtime and morning routines feel like a game. everything is customizable so we can design each routine the way it works for us. It's easy to make adjustments as we keep tweaking our routines. When Im feeling overwhelmed, using the app really helps me relax because I don't have to hold all the tasks in my head, or think about what to do next, and i know I'm not going to forget anything important.

I have ADHD, and RoutineFlow is one of the most useful apps to help keep me on time and on track. In addition to the typical morning routines, etc, I have other routines such as "Prepare to leave house" that has me changing, gathering all my items, and a checklist of items for my dog. Having all the steps with times has really helped me be realistic and aware about the time, and intentional about habit stacking. The app is simple and pleasing to use, well worth the cost to support the dev.

I was looking for a long time for a to-do app or chore app to remind me to do all the little things I neglect or forget about but nothing quite fit and I didn't want the responsibility of taking care of a virtual pet or rpg avatar. This routine app fits my needs perfectly! A morning check list to get my daughter to school without forgetting to put on her sunscreen. Reminders to eat my snack and take a fifteen minute break at work. It's great!

good for it's intended purpose, I imagine, but I mostly use it to track/motivate me to study. I also use it as a checklist for tasks, as well, like in the mornings so I don't forget anything. overall, it's nice to be able to organize things, y'know?

Absolutely revolutionary. It's exactly what I was looking for but made even more convenient (I love the possibility to change the timing for the tasks you took longer/less long to do). The subtasks made by AI can so be helpful for the most daunting tasks. Thank you so much for making this. But it seems the day resets at midnight? I wish users could change that, sometimes I do my evening routine past midnight and then it shows up as completed when I want to do it again before midnight.

i've been using this app for the past three weeks or so now, and it has proven to be very helpful and useful in its simplicity. i really like the timer feature that runs during each routine, as it encourages me to do each item one after the other until the whole routine is done, instead of getting sidetracked like i often do with regular checklists or habit trackers. i use it for my most basic morning and evening routines, which really helps me shift gears at the beginning and end of the day.

Easy to set up, no faffing mid-routine or wasting mental energy deciding what order to complete tasks. I immediately upgraded and also downloaded for my kids (8 & 10) and set up their morning routines on their devices. They love using the app, it's literally transformed our mornings. I don't need to ask if they've brushed their teeth, packed their bags, the app reminds them for me. None of us are diagnosed with ADHD by the way, but it still helps. A weekly task checklist would be awesome too.

Simple and easy to use. I just wanted a digital checklist that can keep me on track. The routines can be repeated on specific days. I really like the audio cue option so I can hear my time is running down. Clean design with dark mode option.

I loooove this app! It's been so helpful helping me stick to my morning and evening routines. Creating subtasks really helps reduce overwhelm, and it's rewarding ticking off each one as I go. The countdown on each task is helpful too, get at least a little bit less distracted trying to stick to the time limit.

This app is really freaking slick. I'm still working on trying to use it everyday, but this is exactly what my ADHD brain needs. Especially after 10 years in the military following checklists. Simplifying my routines into easy to follow checklists has streamline my morning and evening routines. The app also allows you to edit the times for tasks in the routine at the end, so you can really fine tune your routines. Absolutely would recommend, and i did pay for the lifetime premium plan.

I paid for the lifetime subscription because the app looked clean and slick and had a high rating. But it's actually more of a checklist with a built in timer and the countdown gives me anxiety. This app doesn't really work for me in trying to establish healthy routines there is potential for it in the future. I would like to see it more intuitive to delete routines you accidently checked off/undo mistakes. I need more of an app that reminds me when to do things AND give me a timeline.

I've been looking for a customizable checklist app for a long time. The premium version allows me to have multiple routines. Task lists rather than scheduling blocks of time is resulting in having time for everything and getting more done with spare time for relaxing over meals or taking a nap. I love this app.

Great app for those of us with ADHD and time blindness! Having the routine steps planned out with time limits helps so much. I purchased the pro version for the extra options — Dark Mode and Keep Screen On are so worth it. Some glitches at first made me look at other apps, but recent updates have been addressing them (Yay!), so I'll stick with RoutineFlow :) Wishlist: option for a notes or checklist pop up for each routine step (e.g. to remember products I use in my Skincare step)

I never leave reviews but this app is a godsend. I had been trying so many convoluted systems of timers and checklists to keep me on track in the morning and I've never been able to find a good app that can do something like this. This app is simple, clean, and easy to use. My mornings are so much more relaxed: I'm getting a lot more done before work and not feeling rushed to get out the door on time.

So far I love the app. Had me do my morning routine much faster because I didn't have to think about what's next. Just follow the checklist. I did end up cleaning the furnace while making coffee so I guess it still doesn't solve the side quest issue I've been having 😅. I would really love a list for things I've been procrastinating for example hanging a painting, finish the stucco etc...

really like how easy it is to add tasks and especially to rearrange tasks in a routine. It would really benefit from being able o see the "notes" or "context" on a task while it's running -as far as I can tell there's no way to view that while the timer is running. I'd love to be able to put a checklist in my task - "pack clothes" is often a task I put in, and ticking them off as I go would be really helpful

This is the app you're looking for. Don't waste your time with anything else (especially Fabulous).What sets Routinery apart is the schedules and timed routines. It's not just a checklist, it's a structured practice that encourages consistency. App is user friendly, customizable, with smooth performance, a clean interface, and an effective yet minimal notification system. Unlike other apps, these reminders are not overwhelming. Would give more stars if I could. 100% satisfied, will recommend.

For years I've been seeing productivity experts claim that plans/routines are the answer, not motivation or determination. This app does all the work for you to create and maintain productive routines. Your brain no longer has to do the work of going down a checklist, which is especially helpful during foggy-brained mornings. For the first time ever, I consistently accomplish waking up on time, taking meds, meditating, creating art, and reviewing my daily work schedule, all before 8am.

I like the app and as a suggestion is it possible to add sub tasks under habits for example instead of just exercise if we are able to add like 10 pushs 10 Squats 1min plank with 2 or 3 sets and instead of just reading if we are able to add Newspaper (each section under newspaper) ,science textbook , social, any book it will be helpful. If all the sub tasks are completed under a habit we can mark habit for that day completed and also the custom labels are not showing in tick and weekly dashboard

Very good, use app everyday for check list but this really need dark night mode for battery save. And ability to archive check lists for future later use, keep current check lists clean and stay focus

I think this app is wonderful. I would appreciate if you could also introduce an option to include notes or subtasks for each day. E. G if I'm tracking my exercise routine, it would help me to log down number of reps and sets of my workout each day.

I had a surprisingly hard time finding an app that would just give me the same checklist every day without any maintenance. Do my workouts, meditate, take this vitamin or that supplement, work on a creative project, etc. Very many of them would only allow you to set up a checklist for five days, or seven days, or whatever. This app does exactly what i need with no hassles.

I often write checklists for myself to try to solidify daily habits. It's hard when I lose track of the paper, or it doesn't allow space to add notations. With this app, I can have the list in my pocket, update anytime, remind myself what goals I am shooting for, and add whatever notes I want. I like the clean and simple format, too.  The only improvement I can think of would be to add the ability to specify "two days per week" without needing to identify which days. Then you could get a checkmark for the whole week when you fulfil that goal.
Cool idea. Like how it all works and love games so helps me stay on track. Easy to use clean interface. Makes standard day plans and checklists way more fun.

very good, I have adhd and this helps me to be productive and stay on top of chores. My only problem is that I am unable to see the checklist on a daily chore when using the dailies widget. But otherwise, perfectly fine.

the amount of customization and freedom you have with the free version makes me want to pay for it. I've been using it for about a year now and love it. it really gets that little bit of dopeamine needed to keep you entertained and wanting to complete the tasks you make. so far I can make as many as I want. habitual like putting your projects aways, or Dailies like skincare routines and bigger projects with checklists galore! this app has been so helpful! overall must have for the ADD gamer

I have severe depression and anxiety from PTSD. It helps a lot to have a daily checklist, and this also helps me organize weekly chores and one-off tasks. I haven't explored much of the game aspect yet, but I love that there's a character to keep alive and healthy - just like I'm trying to do for myself. It's immediate feedback that I'm on track. I have hatched a few cool animals, but this app is a solid 5/5 just for the utility. Better than other schedulers/checklists that I've tried.

I really love this app - I've been doing it off and on for years and it's just always fun, interesting, really well set up, the in-game items and quests make it so much more fun and rewarding to do real life tasks and chores, and the app doesnt hound you constantly like some other apps (but it can if you want it to). Overall it will always be my go to favorite Todo and checklist app

I've replaced all of my daily checklists with this app. Gamifying my to-do's & daily chores this way motivates me to get those things done a lot sooner, especially if I'm grinding for food drops or trying to level up. Highly recommend if you're looking for an app to track both your habitual to-do's & one-time to-do's 💯
Checklist within tasks doesn't work. I do like that you can set recurring daily things, but if I have to look for another app to plan and manage chores, then it's not particularly good.

Excellent app! Suggestions: 1. Make dailies be able to be a weekly checklist. Example: Work Out 3 times a week, check off for each day you work out that week. 2. Make tasks be represented by illustrations of monsters. 3. Add one more level of difficulty above hard. If you make the tasks monsters, maybe the levels are Baby, Easy, Medium, Hard, and Boss. I found I needed a bit larger scale.

Not just that the added element of RPG is very fun and engaging, but the 
interface and habit/task tracking is very good, too. I love how there are 3 
different sections, I use habit for tasks that I do multiple times a day to 
keep track and get rewarded multiple times. Daily/weekly I use for one-off 
end of day and recurring tasks, such as tidy the kitchen before bed or 
hoover 2x a week . 1 thing I would love if the weekly tasks for example 
would disappear after completing and would only re-appear when they're due 
again!! To-do list is perfect for 1 time tasks. Also love the check list

I've noticed the app not saving information correctly (losing due dates and checklists, for example).  That could be forgiven (still beta), and I still decided to support them for a great concept, however when I did so and went to the in app store it ate some of my diamonds and didn't give me the background pack I requested.  That's not an acceptable bug, even for a beta.

nice app. I hope it will work for me on the long term, but for now it looks like a fun way to do my daily chores. Its nice that when you make a task, that you can make a checklist for that task. But it would be a great addition to be able to check off the checklist. thats why for now it gets 4 stars from me

I love this app, it has been very helpful. Its my number one app. One of the apps that actually makes me complete tasks. I have been looking for an app that gamifies my chores. Its also adhd friendly. But i think there could be some extra features. For example habits could have checklists like the dailies and the to-do's. And it would be great if there was also a "twice a day", "three times a week" option, without having to put certain days (Like for brushing teeth twice a day xd).

This is an amazing app! I love the ui design and feel. It is perfect apart from a few minor/annoying bugs I have found. Apart from those, its perfect! I've noticed that you can't change the order of the tasks in checklists or rename them without starting again, and the back button during the workout menu doesn't work. ilI would also love to see some improvement of the actual workouts. If I could change the reps and weights without having to go back and edit the workout it would be much better.

Absolutely best notes app I've ever used, by a wide margin. I've used it for years to manage a chronic illness. Here's my favorite aspects: - It's fast & easy to add, duplicate, and organize lists, sublists, tasks, and subtasks. - Sublists have an option to automatically move completed tasks to another list or sublist. - I adore the unlimited list colors. - You can set reminders for tasks (hello daily meds!) - You can create tags for tasks. - No adds ever (I use the free version).
Very Easy to use, and you can re-arrange your check list which is very handy when you want to group grocery item together.

Honestly? Amazing! I am approaching exam season and it has been so useful to keep everything organised. This list feature is so useful and makes tasks feel doable. I have a list for exam dates and a list for the revision needed. Love that I can customise everything (colours, sub-tasks, deadlines). Just wish I could sync it to have on my phone and laptop.

You can get as granular as you want to describe all of the aspects of a top line item. Very helpful in breaking down tasks into sub tasks, etc. You forget just how many sub tasks go into a task like "Laundry." I think it satisfies the urge to document all of the steps while simultaneously validating the fact that things like "clean bathroom" and "wash clothes" are collective terms for a group of sub tasks that all require time and effort.

Simple, easy to use, and I like the way you can sort into sublists and subtasks. I'd really like to have subtasks for the subtasks, like for listing specific books under subtask "books" in a list of things to pack. Overall this app is smoother and less clunky than other to-do/list apps I've tried so far.

I love this app. It's so easy to use and organize tasks. I love being able to have main lists for my major categories like Deep Cleaning, Projects, and Daily Tasks, then being able to add sub categories and/ or sub tasks for each section. I really like being able to drag the tasks up or down in my lists to keep them in a logical order. I truly love this app! It has exceeded my expectations.
Best task keeper/check list app I've ever had. I use it for all sorts of things such as groceries, moving in and out of my dorm, reminders, and even for video games!

Hi. I like it so much. Very user friendly. I suggest to be able to check the subtasks thru widget and hide details for today tasks or move the time to the right side to look more simple and clean. Amazing! Keep it up! 👍

I like the sub task feature that lets me break down a task in smaller steps; that helps me remember the details of each task. I also appreciate how I can change where a new task show on lists; at the top allows me to add priorities, the bottom, less important tasks. I organize my thoughts from travel to agendas to meals and anything else that needs planning. The app offers alot without being super scientific or complicated and offers lots of features without being overwhelming. It's just right.

update, 2025 I still absolutely love this app. one of the biggest reasons is the unlimited color options and easily make a chosen color lighter or darker, I love the subtasks, I usually use it for grocery lists or projects that I didn't want mixed in with other tasks. I'm motivated by color. 2021 review: Once I got the hang of how the categories and sub categories work I absolutely love it. There's many colors to choose from and you can flag things etc. I love it. It even has widgets.
I work out of town so this checklist is extremely handy. also for work itself and grocery shopping. this app has been a game changer

I've been hunting for the perfect app for my needs for a very long time. This one is almost perfect, EXCEPT I wish it had a way to have a list without check boxes. I'm also using this to keep information such as emergency contact info and my medicines so I also wish it had a name that indicated that it contained notes as well as tasks, just in case someone needed to find my info fast. Developers, PLEASE!!! make a version that is slightly more univeral than just task checklists.

This is a great app and well thought out. A To-Do list is my primary app and having just moved back to android from iOS I had to find a new one. With numerous tasks to input you can absolutely fly through this really simply & quickly. There's lots of options you can use & these are tucked away on an easily selectable sub layer, keeping your main entries clean & concise. Lists & sub lists, tasks & sub tasks available. Would just ask to be able to pin entries to top of lists. With that, perfect!

My go-to app for simple checklists. I use it for things like a packing checklist for a trip, chores to be done this week, lists of books others have recommended, etc. Best for things where you're not needing to keep extensive notes (I use other apps for things I'm researching where I'll be generating many pages of notes), although it's fine for brief notes to remind you of important details.

So far so good! Not only is it helpful for daily checklists, but I am also using it to organize unimportant documents that have been cluttering my desk, like recipes from magazines or mail that requires a follow-up; I just take a photo and catalog it in a relevant list.

What an AWESOME app! The design is clean, (I especially love the choice of a deep black background), loads of colors to choose from for lists, subtasks under tasks and option to include notes within lists/tasks, priorities, reminders, you can add pictures, and it's a downright beautiful and simple app to use. If you want to sync to a PC the upgrade is at a very reasonable price - this app is perfect!

Simple, clean, intuitive app with great features and user interface. You can make lists easily and the auto suggested colour coding (which you can customise) makes them easy to identify. You can add subtasks and notes to each task. You can highlight important tasks. You can get reminders as notifications or as alarms. And the well thought out user interface makes all of this really easy to use.

Great app to keep myself organized with everything from grocery checklist to workout plan. Upgraded to Premium and since then switched device twice, never have any problem, all data was kept including shared ones. Quite satisfy with the app and havent have any concern so far.

Great app! Does just what I need: keeps track of things I need to do. What makes it even better is if I put grocery store as a task, I can do subtasks that are my shopping list and check things off as I go then check the whole task of Grocery Store off my list, so easy. Love the color changes for each task, urgent in red, less urgent in yellow. Makes those really important tasks easy to spot. Also, I can move them around on the list in order of importance or order I will do them in. So handy!

Still in the testing phase, but it's the best app I've tried so far, and it's really usable. I think the sublist feature will turn out to be really useful in the end by allowing me to break down tasks into subtasks and something like a grocery list into subitems for a particular dish.

Clean intuitive interface with heaps of functionality and configurability. I'd like to see more images and attachments allowed over just the one and sub-sub tasks but otherwise I think this is a solid 5 star gem!

This task list does everything I need, from simple grocery lists to daily reminders to birthdays and anniversaries. I even created a comprehensive checklist for a new home owner's inspection. I can show everything that is due on any particular calendar day, and list any due and overdue tasks. It is easy to use and functionality is high. I'm pleased and grateful for such a useful app. Thanks

You can do so much with this free app! You can set reminders, make separate lists (and merge them!), break each list down into smaller sub-tasks, and more! Importantly, it's also tidy and visually appealing. You can customize the colors associated with each list - great for visual learners! This is an organizatinal tool I would actually stick with...I just hope it remains free to use!

I use this app mostly for recurring checklists (grocery, packing, etc.) and really love the unique feature of nesting subtasks within a task and being able to minimize that task. E.g., in my grocery list, I can minimize a "Cleaning" section to streamline the list view. I cannot express how helpful this is for my brain. I went ahead and got the lifetime premium version. The developer is responsive and communicative and has helped to resolve all my issues so far. I would highly recommend this app.

I got this app a week ago or so and it has been very helpful. My to do lists were always scattered leaving me feeling incomplete, like I'm always forgetting sometime. Only revision would be making sub tasks for sub tasks. Doub sub tasks. Example: Top title: Life interest Category: Buy Task : store sub task: puppy chow Double sub: chocolate..etc.

I can create multiple lists with multiple colors. I can Quick Add or add a more detailed Add with an alarm. I have a check list for groceries, I have events that go off, I have repeating reminders. Very helpful.

I love this app! It is easy to use and helps keep me organized. I especially love the sub tasks, as so much of my daily tasks are broken down into smaller, individual tasks (cleaning by room, for example). Thank you so much, and keep up the great work!
Easy to use. All the functionality I needed. Easy entry, sorting, and subtasks. Clean look. I use this mainly to track items for streaming. Daily checklists and items to setup and games to buy.

This is an AMAZING app. I love the fact that you can not o ly create a checklist, but also add in sub tasks. It's super helpful for work so I can stay on top of what I have to do at each site I visit. Also great for something as simple as a grocery list and I really love the fact that you can customize your list by color. Love it!
Amazing quick, easy to use, task checklist app for my jam packed life!!!!
The app is straightforward and clean. It's easy to enter tasks and subtasks and manage them. I like it and will continue using it.

It's super helpful to stay organized, love the layout and being able to check and uncheck boxes next to each sub-task. Actually used it as a vacation packing list and I can now save it for every trip instead of having to make a new one each time.

I have tried so many task tracking apps because all of them seem to be missing some critical feature, and this one is about as perfect as it gets! Love the lists and sublists, subtasks, notes, and flexible reminder repeat options (seriously, so many apps make this a paid subscription option). The only problem I have with it is the kind of odd way that it handles completing repeating tasks, and I'm hoping this is something that can be slightly altered to make this app perfect! There's two main problems: 1 - When you mark the task as complete, it stays marked as complete until the next time it g

Took a few minutes to figure what they meant and how to set up the sub-tasks. But got it. It'd be great if even after deleting an item it started to remember your 'regular' stuff. But otherwise, I am really loving I can split up the things for the grocery store, the things needed for the house, and stuff yet to do...Thanks!

Have tried multiple to-do list apps and this one has been the most efficient and cleanest one I've come across. You can insert lots of features in a single task like reminders,subtasks priority tags without too much hassle on tapping multiple buttons.The interface is really clean and I love the sublists feature so much, so to whoever the dev is I really appreciate them for creating this app

Awesome app! Very clean, intuitive, and powerful- and no bloated features i dont need. Love the sub-list features and the ability to clone tasks and sublists and reorder them. Ask: Would be nice if there was a way to bold and italicize text, and if the font color for selected text could be changed (i.e. by selecting desired color from a palette). It would also be great if a task/subtask could be marked as partially done or in progress by changing the task circle to a ¼, ½ or ¾ filled in circle.

I use this app as a piece to the puzzle of my most productive days. Every night before putting my phone down for the night I use it to create my TODO for tomorrow. I also have my morning and evening routines written out with timestamps written in the 'subtasks'. After trying a bunch of task apps, I settled in this one because it has every customization I could need.

So far, so good. I needed something to remind me to take my meds and to also show me if I already took them so I don't double-dose. The terms "Lists", "tasks", "sub-lists" and "subtasks" get a little confusing, and when you complete a repeating daily task, it simply copies the completed task to the next day. It shows the next day's task as completed until midnight, then it shows it as not completed. It's a little counter-intuitive to me but now that I know how it works I can carry on. 😊

My favorite list making app. Love that I can add subtasks and little notes on tasks. Helps me stay organized and remember what I have left to do or problems I ran into. I used it for working on my cars and cleaning the house among other things. Fun colors keep the mood light:)

I'm a busy woman: single mother of two teens, executive assistant to two entrepreneurs, and a college student. Having this app available at my beck 'n call is a Godsend! I keep business tasks, personal priorities, grocery lists, & mommy-to-do checklists readily available through the app. It's having my 'paper brains' organized & conveniently located with the touch of a button. Helps with stress relief too. Absolutely necessary for working mommas!

I have a disability affecting memory and organisation, and this app is almost perfect for planning my day. The only thing that could improve it would be a second layer of nesting for subtasks e.g. "kitchen" as a subtask of "clean house" and "empty bin" as a subtask of "kitchen". Lists of subtasks can get very long, messy, and overwhelming when everything has to fit into one layer. I would upgrade to premium if it provided this feature but 5 stars regardless as I am using this app for free.

I love this app! I use this for my grocery list and many other lists. I love the way you can list your tasks and subtasks. I really like that you and easily rearrange the list. I also like how you can set yourself a reminder notification. I inadvertently changed a setting so I contacted the creator and got an answer right away! I am very satisfied!

I really love this app, but it's not perfect. Here's my thoughts: Pros: - Allows you to make reminders either a push notification OR AN ALARM. This is VERY hard to find in a reminder app. - Highly flexible and customizable, allowing you to set priority, add sub-tasks, custom snooze lengths, etc. Cons: - Not a super clean interface. - Not always an intuitive interface. - The widget often gets behind.
